en: al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Wazzan al-Fasi (Leo Africanus)
tr: el-Hasen b. Muhammed el-Vezzân el-Fâsî (Leo Africanus)

description.tr: Afrika Tasviri dört yüzyıl boyunca Avrupa'nın Afrika kıtası bilgisinin birincil kaynağıydı || Korsanlar tarafından yakalanıp Papa X. Leo'ya sunuldu, 'Joannes Leo' olarak vaftiz edildi ama muhtemelen daha sonra İslam'a döndü. || [Tarih notu] Amin Maalouf'un 'Leo Africanus' romanı (1986) hikâyesini küresel ilgiye taşıdı.
description.en: His Description of Africa was the primary source for European knowledge of the African continent for four centuries — a Muslim-born scholar writing in Italian at the papal court || Captured by pirates and presented to Pope Leo X, he was baptized 'Joannes Leo' but likely returned to Islam later. His unique position between two civilizations produced the most important geographic work of the Renaissance. || [Historiographical note] Amin Maalouf's novel 'Leo Africanus' (1986) brought his story to global attention. The historical al-Wazzan remains a symbol of cross-cultural knowledge exchange.
description.ar: كان وصفه لأفريقيا المصدر الأساسي لمعرفة أوروبا بالقارة الأفريقية لأربعة قرون || أسره قراصنة وقُدم للبابا ليو العاشر، وعُمّد باسم يوحنا ليو
